title: Agent invents a npm/PyPI package that does not exist
symptoms: Install fails with package not found
Import errors for modules never published
README claims a library that search cannot find
cause: Models may hallucinate plausible package names; trusting the suggestion without verifying the registry creates broken builds and supply-chain risk.
solution: Verify every new dependency against the official registry and docs before install; prefer packages already in the repo; reject agent patches that add unverified deps.
workaround: Pin to known packages and ask the agent to implement without new dependencies.
